evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Speaker supplies the factual frame — a known production failure pattern — as the basis for what follows, exercising informational power by controlling the facts that define the situation.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Bare imperatives with no justification or appeal — insistence on compliance, the hallmark of pressure as an influence tactic.
